meta.title: ThermoGeneva — Industrial building thermal benchmark
meta.description: Compare the thermal performance (IDC) of buildings in Geneva's industrial zones against similar buildings, using official open data.

footer.source: Source: SITG / OCEN — IDC and FTI industrial zones, open data (class A). Base map © swisstopo. Values transformed by ThermoGeneva (see Methodology).
footer.disclaimer: Indicative screening tool. Not an energy audit and not an official decision.

home.title: How does this building's heating compare to similar buildings?
home.lead: ThermoGeneva turns the official Geneva heat index (IDC) into comparisons: each building in the FTI industrial zones is benchmarked against buildings of the same type across the canton, with its trend and its position relative to legal thresholds.
home.q2: Is it high or low compared with similar buildings?
home.q3: Is it improving or getting worse?
home.q4: Is it close to Geneva's legal thresholds?
home.notText: ThermoGeneva does not measure process energy or total factory consumption, and does not replace an energy audit. It is a screening layer that shows where a closer technical look may be worthwhile.

building.thresholdsText: Geneva's energy regulation compares the 3-year average IDC with thresholds. Above 450 MJ/m², owners must take improvement measures; above the "significant" threshold, energy renovation is mandatory (800 until 2026, 650 from 2027, 550 from 2031).
building.thresholdNote: Indicative reading based on published data. Only the cantonal energy office (OCEN) determines obligations.
building.heatPumpNote: For heat pumps the IDC counts electricity used, which lowers the value compared with fuel-based systems.
building.finalEnergyNote: IDC × SRE, climate-normalised: heating and hot water only, not process energy.
